work.permit: Permission of the competent authority (主管機關許可)

note: Majority: the Civil Code (民法), article 12, 'a person of full eighteen years is of age' (the age was twenty until the amendment of 2021 came into force on 1 January 2023); a married minor's capacity and the rules on a minor's contracts with the legal representative's consent are not held. Work: the Labor Standards Act (勞動基準法, as amended 31 July 2024), article 45, bars an employer from employing a person under fifteen, except one who has finished junior high school or whose work the competent authority finds harmless to body and mind and permits; the same article applies the rule and the child-worker protections to a person under fifteen who is paid for services without an employment relationship, which is how a child performer is held, so a performer under fifteen works with the competent authority's permission, at no age floor the Act sets. Those aged fifteen to sixteen are child workers (article 44) with hours limits not held here; apprentices are under article 64. Service: the Military Service Act (兵役法, as amended 3 May 2023), article 3, makes men liable from 1 January of the year after they turn eighteen until 31 December of the year they turn thirty-six (held as 18 to 36); article 16 sets active service of conscripted soldiers at one year (12 months). Women aren't conscripted (article 1 binds men); the four-month military training and alternative service are not held.

sources.said: 十五歲以上未滿十六歲之受僱從事工作者，為童工。 ... 雇主不得僱用未滿十五歲之人從事工作。但國民中學畢業或經主管機關認定其工作性質及環境無礙其身心健康而許可者，不在此限。 ... 未滿十五歲之人透過他人取得工作為第三人提供勞務，或直接為他人提供勞務取得報酬未具勞僱關係者，準用前項及童工保護之規定。

sources.said: 中華民國男子依法皆有服兵役之義務。 ... 男子年滿十八歲之翌年一月一日起役，至屆滿三十六歲之年十二月三十一日除役，稱為役齡男子。 ... 一、現役：以徵兵及齡男子，經徵兵檢查合格於除役前，徵集入營服之，為期一年，期滿退伍。
